name: Athens University of Economics and Business
summary: Athens business and economics university; its one English-taught degree is a four-year BSc in International Business and Technology.

handoff.label: International Business and Technology: how to apply

ib.text: The IB Diploma is named as an accepted qualification, with no points or subjects stated; last two school years must be on site abroad, plus B2 English proof.

apply.via: IBT online form and documents to ibt@aueb.gr

programmes.name: International Business and Technology
programmes.about: Four-year BSc (240 ECTS) taught entirely in English: management, accounting, economics, statistics, AI and data analytics in years 1-2, then a Management, Leadership and Strategy or a Technology and Analytics stream, plus an internship.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma accepted, no points stated; you must have attended your last two school years full-time abroad (not in Greece) and show B2 English (TOEFL, TOEIC or IELTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling review of school transcripts, CV and English certificate; a personal interview may be requested. Merit scholarships reduce the fee. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The degree is addressed only to foreign citizens, EU or not, who did their last two school years full-time in a school abroad, or at an international school in Greece if neither they nor their parents are Greek citizens.
Fees are paid in three instalments of €2,000 in the first year, the first as a deposit on receiving the acceptance letter, then two a year from year two.
